Cross-cluster ownership is not proven by the packet: most owners are UnknownObject; DERIVED owners are the widget-hierarchy teardown (abi:lead) and the scene-instance collection (abi:lead) for the two rebuild functions.

GameOptionsState (0x004C1E80) parses the config stream, building a career-season node list (head this+0, tail this+4) and filling totals/records and race/game-option fields. RebuildFilteredNodeArray (0x00545A40) and RebuildSceneInstanceArray (0x00545BB0) rebuild length-prefixed 24-byte-entry arrays from two node lists by matching chain flags.
